evidence.finding: Routing configuration version 24.7 was deployed to all queues at exactly 09:15, matching incident onset.
Transfer rate increased from 6.49% at 09:00 to 12.23% at 09:15 and remained above 12%; the post-onset average was 101.5% higher.
AHT increased from 382.7 seconds at 09:00 to 505.4 seconds at 09:15 and averaged 35.0% above its pre-incident level.
All queues showed 87.6%–116.9% transfer-rate increases and 35.1%–37.7% AHT increases, consistent with the deployment's all-queue scope, though service-level severity varied by queue.
Scheduled and logged-in staffing remained at 49, while productive staffing changed by less than 1%.
Offered calls averaged 6.1% lower after incident onset, contradicting a demand surge.

primary_root_cause_detail: The all-queue deployment of routing configuration version 24.7 at 09:15 is the likely upstream cause. It coincided with a broad doubling of transfer rates, which increased handle time, reduced throughput, and degraded service level despite stable staffing and non-increasing demand.
recommended_actions: Roll back or disable routing configuration version 24.7 and verify transfer rate, AHT, ASA, and service-level recovery.
Audit the deployment's routing rules and destination mappings for loops, unnecessary handoffs, or incorrect skill assignments.
Add post-deployment monitoring and automatic rollback thresholds for transfer rate, AHT, and service level by queue.

rejected_hypotheses.reason: Aggregate offered volume decreased after onset, and three of four queues had lower volume.
Scheduled and logged-in staffing remained constant, with essentially unchanged productive staffing.
No platform event was visible; the only recorded event was the routing deployment.
Service level recalculated exactly from visible counts in all 16 intervals, with zero mismatch.

stakeholder_summary: A 09:15 all-queue routing deployment is the likely cause of the service-level incident. Transfers doubled and AHT rose about 35%, reducing throughput while staffing remained stable and demand did not increase.
